text: τὰ καλὰ ζῷα παίζει μετὰ τοῦ Ὑπερβρέφους τῇ σφαίρᾳ. χαίρουσι πάλιν.
objects: Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled.
artist_notes: Keep the vibe bright and celebratory; subtle sparkles or sun motes are okay.
positioning: Glaux mid-left gently tosses the ball toward Hyperbrephos, front three-quarter, joyful expression.
Hyperbrephos mid-center prepares to catch, front three-quarter, laughing.
Panda mid-right claps happily, front three-quarter, watching the pass.
Bright red leather ball, palm-sized, perfectly round with a subtle stitched seam arcs between Glaux and Hyperbrephos.
Broad low-branched oak-like shade tree with lush olive-green leaves and textured warm-brown bark stands behind the group.
Smooth palm-sized gray river stone, oval, slightly speckled stays unused at the edge of the play area.
